name: Hazard Protocol
description: The house style shared by every domain: dark, heavy and utilitarian, with visible structure. N-scale neutrals carry the bodies (light gray primary, dark gray secondary) on a near-black ground; Hazard Orange is the one accent and marks only what is functional. Kode Mono for display, body and numbers; tags in uppercase, descriptions in sentence case; callout leaders run orthogonally and end in a dot. House marks apply.

notes.identity.words: From the render guide's mood rules (dark, heavy, utilitarian; hazard orange as functional emphasis) and the PCB theme's description (industrial and utilitarian).
notes.marks.clearSpace: Research note: a published hardware brand guide sets the clear zone around a logo equal to the logo's height (dfm-research 06, section A.4).
notes.marks.logo: The Protoboard logo from the repository's design/brand folder, registered in assets/registry.json; a trademark (see NOTICE).
notes.palette.accent: Hazard Orange, from the Hazard Protocol render style guide (section 1, core tokens); the same value as the document house style's accent.
notes.palette.accent.dark: Shadow band of Hazard Orange in the render guide's three-band cel shading.
notes.palette.accent.light: Lit band of Hazard Orange in the render guide.
notes.palette.background: Render guide background fill: near-black, not pure black.
notes.palette.body: Render guide: N-200 is the primary body color.
notes.palette.bodySecondary: Render guide: N-800 is the secondary (supporting, structural) body color.
notes.palette.ink: Render guide: edge lines on light bodies use N-950.
notes.palette.muted: Render guide: secondary callout leaders use N-500.
notes.type.family.display: House choice: Kode Mono is the face of the document house style and the app; the render guide lists other industrial faces for render titles, which a render branch may keep.
notes.voice.callouts.route: Render guide section 5: orthogonal segments only, one right-angle bend at most, no arrowheads.
notes.voice.tags.case: Render guide: uppercase for component identifiers; the PCB theme sets its tags and titles in uppercase too.
